summary: Fluent relation API: Relation class (method chaining for filter/sort/join/group_by/head/select/conform/unnest/params/etc.), GroupedRelation, relation() factory, concat() function, RelationProjectionBuilder, and OptimisationRegistry for extensible AST rewriting.
extension_points: OptimisationRegistry allows pipeline/extension modules to register AST rewriting passes without modifying the relation API
lifecycle_notes: 2026-05: Added OptimisationRegistry, Relation.conform() now delegates to conform._build_conform_exprs
2026-05 (PR #160): Added Relation.params(**kwargs) — wraps node in ParamsRelNode from pipelines.integration
2026-05 (PR #147): Added Relation.unnest(*columns, separator) — expands struct columns via ExtensionRelNode(UNNEST)
2026-05: to_pandas() now calls self.collect() and handles pd.DataFrame directly
documentation_hooks: Relation.params(**kwargs): pipeline parameter binding; requires an upstream PipelineStepRelNode to fold into
Relation.unnest(*columns, separator=sep): struct expansion; not yet supported on Narwhals backend
